introduction.title: Understanding Piles (Arsha) in Ayurveda
introduction.description: Ayurveda views piles (Arsha) primarily as a result of poor dietary habits, sedentary lifestyle, and impaired digestion (Mandagni), leading to constipation and the accumulation of toxins. Our treatment focuses on correcting digestion and shrinking the hemorrhoidal mass naturally.

approach.title: Our Treatment Approach
approach.description: We employ a multi-faceted approach to manage piles effectively:

items.title: Digestive Correction
items.description: Herbal medicines to improve digestion (Agni) and relieve constipation.

items.title: Local Applications
items.description: Soothing Ayurvedic ointments and oils for local relief from pain and itching.

items.title: Dietary Guidelines

steps.title: Detailed Assessment
steps.description: Understanding your symptoms, dietary habits, and lifestyle.

steps.title: Root Cause Analysis

steps.title: Holistic Plan

items.question: Do I need surgery for piles?
items.answer: Many early-stage piles can be effectively managed with Ayurvedic medicines, diet, and lifestyle changes without surgery. Our doctors will assess your condition and advise accordingly.

items.question: What kind of diet should I follow?
items.answer: A diet high in fiber, adequate hydration, and avoiding spicy, processed, and heavy foods is generally recommended.

items.question: Is the Ayurvedic treatment painful?
items.answer: The medical management of piles using oral herbs and local applications is painless and soothing.
